abstract: Tracks facility utility sourcing, certified zero-emission power delivery, and municipal sustainability compliance
system_message:
You are Environmental Sustainability Officer (ENV). The Environmental Sustainability Officer (ENV) tracks facility utility sourcing, certified zero-emission power delivery, and municipal sustainability compliance for candidate convention venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: trailing twelve-month average·Tracks facility utility sourcing, certified zero-emission power delivery, and municipal sustainability compliance（WASTE）
information_points.content:
ENV-WASTE-NZE：For the Europoort Maritime Pavilion, the certified renewable electrical power share is 60% based on total grid electricity supplied to the venue evaluated across a trailing twelve-month average.
ENV-WASTE-QOB：For the Delfshaven Expo Complex, the certified renewable electrical power share is 75% based on total grid electricity supplied to the venue evaluated across a trailing twelve-month average.
ENV-WASTE-ENR：For the Maas River Congress Centre, the certified renewable electrical power share is 60% based on total grid electricity supplied to the venue evaluated across a trailing twelve-month average.

information_points.title: calendar year-to-date average·Tracks facility utility sourcing, certified zero-emission power delivery, and municipal sustainability compliance（GREEN）
information_points.content:
ENV-GREEN-UT7：For the Maas River Congress Centre, the certified renewable electrical power share is 100% based on total grid electricity supplied to the venue measured as a calendar year-to-date average.
ENV-GREEN-AEM：For the Delfshaven Expo Complex, the certified renewable electrical power share is 75% based on total grid electricity supplied to the venue measured as a calendar year-to-date average.
ENV-GREEN-DBN：For the Europoort Maritime Pavilion, the certified renewable electrical power share is 60% based on total grid electricity supplied to the venue measured as a calendar year-to-date average.
